answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond that is slashed when its attestations are proven false, and let peers audit a random sample of each identity's work each epoch. A newcomer starts on a low knoll: it may attest small jobs, but its bond only grows into full earning rights after several epochs of verified work. A falcon-like spotter, an auditor drawn at random, checks samples against a quartz-clear public log, so minting a hundred fake identities means funding a hundred bonds and surviving a hundred audits. Sybil cost scales with identities, while one honest agent pays once.
